name: DuPage County, IL
findings: DuPage County has 3,513 nonprofit organizations. 1,522 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,269 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, DuPage County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 291 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 291 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
